comparator.name: History
comparator.sourceNotes: Groningen begins with a chronological survey, then develops political, cultural, social and economic history through research seminars. The redesigned final year shown here combines a minor, an interdisciplinary choice, regional public history and a thesis.

components.name: A Global History of the Netherlands
History II: The Making of the Modern World, 1500–1945
IMPACT course: Global Changes or Cultural Heritage
components.note: Choose one 10 EC course in Global Change or Cultural Heritage.

components.name: Minor
components.note: The programme reserves a semester for a 30 EC minor.

components.name: IMPACT course
components.note: Choose one course in Cultural Heritage, Global Change, Humane AI and the Digital Society, or Stories We Live By.

components.name: Regions III: Specialization and Public History
components.note: Study a region in depth and learn to communicate historical research to the public. Complete the first year before taking this course.

components.name: BA Thesis
components.note: The regulations require completion of years one and two before the thesis.
